gallery.title: Art Gallery
gallery.description: Explore a curated collection of SummerFloofy’s illustrations featuring character art, VTuber fanart, and artwork of her original character, Floofy. With expressive posing, soft rendering, and carefully balanced color palettes, each piece reflects her distinct artistic style and attention to detail.

learn.title: Discover SummerFloofy
learn.description: Learn more about SummerFloofy, explore commission opportunities, and join live streams with the Tangerine community.

about.title: About
about.description: SummerFloofy is a digital illustrator and streamer known for expressive character artwork and a welcoming creative community. Her work includes VTuber fanart and illustrations of her original character, Floofy, blending personality, color, and detail. She is supported by her community of fans, known as the Tangerines, who play a big part in shaping the positive and creative space around her work.

commission.title: Commissions
commission.description: Bring your ideas to life with custom artwork created in SummerFloofy’s signature style. Whether you’re looking for character art, VTuber-inspired illustrations, or personalized artwork, each commission is crafted with care and attention to detail.

streaming.title: Streaming
streaming.description: Join SummerFloofy live for drawing sessions, creative chats, and community interaction with the Tangerines. Streams offer a behind-the-scenes look at the artistic process and a space to connect, relax, and create together.

support.title: Support SummerFloofy’s journey
support.description: Whether you’re sharing artwork, leaving a review, donating, or stopping by a stream, every bit of support helps SummerFloofy continue creating and growing.

reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.description: See what clients and members of the Tangerine community have shared about their experiences with SummerFloofy’s artwork and commissions. Feedback helps others understand the process and highlights the support behind each piece.

donate.title: Donate
donate.description: Support SummerFloofy’s art, streams, and future projects. Every contribution helps fund new creative work, improve content, and keep the community thriving.

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: Have a question, collaboration idea, or commission inquiry? Reach out anytime through the contact page — SummerFloofy would love to hear from you.

hero.title: ABOUT
hero.description: Background, interests, socials, and everything from the artist behind the art.

news.title: LATEST NEWS
news.description: Stay updated with the latest news and updates from Floofy. Follow on Twitter for real-time updates, behind-the-scenes content, and more.

artist.name: Summer Floofy
artist.short_desc: SummerFloofy is an illustrator and streamer who creates fan arts and original works. From beloved character interpretations to wholly original designs, every piece reflects a warm, expressive style that has captured hearts across the internet.
artist.extended_desc: With a passion for storytelling through art, SummerFloofy brings characters to life with vibrant colors and emotive detail. Streaming regularly on Twitch, they invite the community into the creative process—from rough sketches to polished finals—building a space that's as much about connection as it is about craft.

social.description: You can find additional Floofy art on other platforms.

tweet.title: Latest News
tweet.description: For all the lastest art updates, stream announcements, and community posts, follow SummerFloofy on X/Twitter.

pricing_section.title: Commission Types
pricing_section.description: Base pricing includes one character. See each card below for what is included and excluded.

chibi.title: Chibi
chibi.notes_1: Please provide pose/expression references if possible
chibi.turnaround_2: May take longer depending on complexity

emotes.title: Emotes
emotes.includes_2: Basic props (eating, sleeping, holding a heart or flower, etc.)
emotes.notes_1: Please provide pose/expression references if possible
emotes.notes_2: Using it as emotes on your Twitch or YouTube is considered personal usage and not commercial (no extra 50% charge)
emotes.notes_3: You are welcome to post the illustration anywhere as long as you credit Summer Floofy
emotes.turnaround_2: May take longer depending on complexity

illustration.title: Illustration
illustration.notes_1: Complex character designs may incur additional fees
illustration.turnaround_2: May take up to 1 month during busy periods or for highly detailed pieces

terms.title: Commission Terms
terms.description: Policies, workflow, and terms for all commission requests.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.item_1: Base pricing includes one character only
pricing.item_2: Additional characters, props, and backgrounds cost extra depending on complexity
pricing.item_3: Complex character designs may incur additional fees
pricing.item_4: Prices do not include 5% sales tax

revisions.title: Revisions
revisions.item_3: Additional revisions may incur extra charges
revisions.item_4: Major revision examples: pose changes, expression changes

communication.title: Communication
communication.body: If you have questions, updates, or simply want to chat about your commission, contact me through VGen or email. I normally send a follow-up email after one day if there is no reply on messaging platforms.

payment.title: Payment
payment.item_2: Work begins only after payment is received

tos.title: Terms of Service
tos.usage_item_1: Please use commissions for your own exclusive personal use
tos.usage_item_2: Do not use commissions for commercial use or distribution unless discussed
tos.ip_item_1: Some commissioned works may be used in my portfolio. If you want your piece to remain private, please mention it during discussion.
tos.ip_item_2: Extensive external modifications (painting over or AI modifications) are not allowed without permission.
tos.ip_item_3: You may not use my artwork for AI training.
tos.ip_item_4: My artworks are not authorized for blockchain-related technologies such as NFTs or cryptocurrency.
tos.conduct_item_1: Harassment, spam, or repeated rule violations may result in blacklist/rejection
tos.conduct_item_2: I reserve the right to reject any commission request

inquire.title: Submit a Request
inquire.subtitle: Let's bring your ideas into reality!
inquire.description: Fill out this form to inquire about a commission, and Floofy will reach out to discuss the process with you ASAP!

additional_notes.label: Additional Notes
additional_notes.placeholder: Please specify any additional concerns or requirements regarding the commission if needed, such as deadline.
